name: Royal Snowrealm Okroshkas
desc:
A cold soup prepared by Danica herself. Somehow, simply adding "Royal" to its name seems to make it taste even better.
Rumor has it that it was made using a secret recipe only known to the maids of the Zapolyarny Palace, though Danica denies any such thing.

value.text: Increases all party members' DEF by 235 for 300s. In Co-Op Mode, this effect only applies to your own character(s).
